Phase 5, Week 4, Tue
Workout Specific Movement Prep
View Workout Specific Movement Prep
- This is progression 2/3 for our benchmark workout, "Everest"
- The goal today, is to hold a pace, for all 3 movements, which you think you will hold for the test
- Perform your deadlift unbroken
- The final tester will be 75% of bodyweight, if you feel you may need to scale this to achieve the reps, please do
- Your initial 1000m run buy in should take no longer than 6:30 today
A. As Many Rounds and Reps as possible in 15 minutes, with Buy In:
Buy In:
Run 1000 meters
Then AMRAP:
15 Deadlifts @ 75% bodyweight
20 Burpees
Run 400 meters
- RUN DISTANCE
800 to 1000m
300 to 400m
---- REST 3 MINS BEFORE THE NEXT PART ---
B. As Many Rounds and Reps as possible in 15 minutes, with Buy In:
Buy In:
Run 1000 meters
Then AMRAP:
30 Wall Ball Shots @ 20 or 14 lbs
20 Burpees
Run 400 meters
- RUN DISTANCE
800 to 1000m
300 to 400m
C. ACCESSORIES
Active Recovery Bike Erg for 10 minutes
- Treat this as a 'cool-down' from the session
- Perform on a low damper, easy pace
- Nasal breathing
2 alternating sets of:
D1. Ghd Side Lying Pallof Hold for 30-40 seconds
- Anti-side flexion exercise
- Rest 30-40s between sides and sets
Rest 30 seconds
D2. Cable Cuban Presses: 12 or 15 reps (3010 tempo)
- RIR 2-3
Rest 30 seconds
D3. 10-12 10 Degree Incline Side Lying DB Powell Raises (3010 tempo)
- Rear delt/rhomboid
Rest 30 seconds
Show less
